key_insight: PsyBridge combines standard mental health screeners with cognitive and personality signals to produce a more interpretable, multi-dimensional risk assessment.
clinical_relevance: This hybrid framework could help digital and telehealth settings support more comprehensive, explainable mental health triage and decision-making.
method: Uses PHQ-9 and GAD-7 alongside cognitive and behavioural indicators
Applies a modular architecture with weighted aggregation for risk classification
Includes sensitivity analysis and ablation testing to assess stability and component value
evidence_signal: In a semi-synthetic dataset of 500 patient profiles, PsyBridge achieved 0.84 overall accuracy and outperformed standalone PHQ-9 and GAD-7 assessments.
watch_item: Because the dataset was semi-synthetic, real-world performance, fairness, and clinical workflow integration still need validation before deployment.
paper_title: PsyBridge: A Hybrid Intelligent Framework for Multi-Dimensional Mental Health Assessment and Decision Support
